settings.heading: The Cashmere Silhouette
settings.subheading: Hand-tailored coats spun from rare Mongolian baby cashmere. Designed for effortless architectural structure.

settings.heading: Slow Spun. Deep Comfort.
settings.body: Spun on heritage wooden spindles in Inner Mongolia, our baby cashmere has an exceptionally long fiber length (38mm) that naturally resists pilling and drapes with heavy liquidity.

settings.quote: Beautiful drape. The cashmere overcoat feels incredibly soft yet holds its architectural structure perfectly.
settings.name: Alistair C.

settings.quote: Heavyweight silk that moves with absolute grace. A stunning addition to my wardrobe.
settings.name: Marlowe V.

settings.quote: Superb tailoring. The trousers fit like bespoke and the wool quality is outstanding.
settings.name: Julian K.
